text: Post-1998 hedge fund regulatory proposals were misdirected because LTCM was unique among its peers in leverage, position size, and market-making ability, so the proposals mostly addressed LTCM as a single case rather than the range of issues affecting all hedge funds.
citation: Kaal, Hedge Fund Valuation Retailization, Regulation, and Investor Suitability (2009). SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=1428387

isBasedOn.name: Hedge Fund Valuation Retailization, Regulation, and Investor Suitability

abstract: Because LTCM was so unique among its peers due to its leverage, the size of its positions and its market making abilities, regulatory proposals mostly addressed LCTM as a single case119 rather than the range of issues pertaining to all hedge funds.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: regulatory proposals issued in the aftermath of the LTCM near-collapse
